pr_body:
Fix https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/issues/4005

NOTE: To implement these features it was required to refactor the existing code related to the tabs widgets creation.
pr_comments: @martincapello if you have used a .lua script to test this, could you please share it here or in a [gist](https://gist.github.com/)?

Now is ready for review, besides introducing your suggestions, I have fixed a couple of things:
- Set same tab page size for all tabs using the max size of all the tab pages of the group. This avoids an annoying resize of the dialog when changing tabs.
- Fix expansiveness of the tab content. Now when you set the vexpand=true for an :endtabs{} it will work as expected.

issue_context.title: Add missing features to Tab widget
issue_context.body:
- [x] Include which is the selected tab when asking for Dialog.data.
- [x] Add possibility to change the position of the tabs selector to the bottom.
- [x] ~~Add selected flag to each tab?~~ Currently the selected attribute of the endtabs() parameter is used to set the initial selected tab and it seems to be enough.
- [x] Add onclick event handlers to each tab() and ontabchange event handler to endtabs().

review_comments: I'm not a big fan of exposing these internal flags as they are, but it's the most simple way, we can keep this as is.
